long_biography.plain_text:
Australian equipment designer Roland Tyson worked with Paramjeet Singh on a collapsible container that combined a flexible wall with a rigid base. Their design allowed the sides to fold down for packing while retaining a firm surface underneath, addressing the space taken up by conventional camping containers.

Tyson also mentored product designer Tim Miller, who joined Sea to Summit straight from university. With office space limited, they shared a desk for several years. Tyson could follow drawings and prototypes as they developed, helping Miller correct an approach before taking it too far. Designers followed their products through factory production, quality control, packaging and sales presentations.
